title: Rethinking Video Agents: When and Why Video Harnesses Work
abstract: arXiv:2611.31883v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video understanding depends not only on how models reason about visual evidence, but also on which evidence they observe. Fixed observation policies determine this evidence in advance; agentic harnesses allow models to seek further observations as their understanding develops. This shift creates an opportunity to realize capabilities that fixed inputs leave untapped, yet the ability to request observations does not ensure their effective use. We investigate when and why video harnesses improve understanding, examining how task demands and models' capacity for interaction jointly shape their benefits. Using Video-Relook as an experimental framework, we let models adapt their temporal and spatial observations from a common default configuration, and analyze performance and interaction trajectories across models and tasks. Adaptive observation yields substantial gains on fine-grained action understanding, with benefits also extending to V

translated_title: 重新思考视频智能体：视频工具框架何时以及为何有效
translated_abstract: 视频理解不仅取决于模型如何对视觉证据进行推理，还取决于它们观察到哪些证据。固定的观察策略会预先确定这些证据；而智能体式工具框架则允许模型随着理解的深入主动寻求更多观察。这一转变创造了释放固定输入所未能挖掘的潜力的机会，然而，请求观察的能力并不保证这些观察能被有效利用。我们研究了视频工具框架何时以及为何能改善理解，考察任务需求与模型的交互能力如何共同塑造其收益。我们以Video-Relook作为实验框架，让模型从统一的默认配置出发自适应地调整其时间维度和空间维度上的观察，并分析跨模型、跨任务的性能表现与交互轨迹。自适应观察在细粒度动作理解上带来了显著收益，其收益还延伸至……（原文摘要截断于此）
tldr: 该研究利用Video-Relook实验框架系统探索了视频智能体工具框架何时以及为何有效，发现自适应的时间与空间观察策略能显著提升细粒度动作理解能力，且其收益由任务需求与模型的交互能力共同决定。
en_tdlr: Using Video-Relook as an experimental framework, this work investigates when and why video agentic harnesses improve understanding, showing that adaptive temporal and spatial observation yields substantial gains on fine-grained action understanding, with benefits jointly shaped by task demands and models' interaction capacity.
